researchRules: Atlas Concept.id is an opaque atlas identity until an external mapping is independently evidenced.
Mesh membership is not ontology equivalence.
Public mirrors/access copies may be used to inspect text, but authority belongs to the identified book/edition/source, not to the mirror host.
No majority vote resolves substantive authoritative-source conflicts.
Do not mechanically compose canonical Vietnamese labels from base term + laterality/direction.
A source-consensus candidate is not MEDICAL_REVIEWED or release-eligible.
Exact edition-matched locators must be pinned before SOURCE_VERIFIED.
No record in this artifact may satisfy production review/release gates by itself.
